test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold.

The choice was __**judicious **__as further events proved.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **prudent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"judicious"** means having, showing, or done with good judgment or sense. (समझदार)

 
 
• **Example: **His judicious use of resources ensured that the project was completed on time.
 
 
 
• **"Prudent"** refers to acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (विवेकी)
 
 
• **Example: **It was prudent to save money for emergencies.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'judicious'** is **'prudent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **prudent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Silly** (मूर्ख): Lacking in good sense or judgment.

 
 
• **Example:** It was silly of him to forget his keys.
 
 
 
• **Hasty** (जल्दबाजी में): Done with excessive speed or urgency.
 
 
• **Example: **He made a hasty decision without considering all the facts.
 
 
 
• **Ridiculous** (हास्यास्पद): Deserving or inviting derision or mockery.
 
 
• **Example:** The idea was so ridiculous that everyone laughed.
